ambiguity: D3_MAP_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS / SCORING_FAILURE, not PASS or arbitrary singleton fallback.

applicabilityInterface.access: Owner-controlled privileged applicability binder and independent verifier before execution; privileged scorer consumes read-only after output freeze. D3 author/product runner/implementation author cannot read protected mappings. Public output exposes only aggregate readiness/digests; detailed item trace remains restricted.
applicabilityInterface.freeze: Privileged binding bytes plus their digest, scope catalogue/map/contract/universe/schema digests, IV PASS and Owner acceptance must be bound before final execution. Missing privileged binding is future admission stop, not author permission to invent benchmark mappings.

input.frozenRequiredPropositionRefs: restricted gold pointers, only privileged scorer reads

lookupProcedure: Verify benchmark/map/universe/contract/privileged-binding digests, independent IV receipt, Owner acceptance and authorized scorer role before resolving any item.
Lookup exactly one frozen row per required-proposition pointer. A missing row, duplicate disagreeing row, unauthorized course, foreign scope or missing contribution is a scoring failure.
Resolve all required propositions to one pre-frozen item counting context. Never generate scopes or equivalence from runtime question/answer wording.

Resolve contribution vectors for C and R from the accepted context binding. Vectors contain all material scopes admitted by that context, including declared residual contributions. Emit one unit key per identity in that context.
Compute the unchanged quotient cardinalities for C and R; per-atomic-scope diagnostic counts are never summed or averaged into a new D3 metric.

output.score: exact rational or preserved empty handling

restrictedBindingRow.contextId: one approved item C/R counting context
restrictedBindingRow.identityContributionBindings: every participating authorized identity -> ordered scope IDs with canonical group IDs OR explicitly accepted distinct contribution; residual/additional used material also explicit
restrictedBindingRow.scopeIds: sorted exact public corpus scope IDs
restrictedBindingRow.usedSourceSpanBindings: Each participating evidence identity -> exact used UTF-8 intervals, sourceSpanId/relative fragment where overlapping, atomic proposition contribution and independently justified outside material; privileged content remains restricted.

applicabilityInterface.scopeIdSemantics: SHA256 of canonical corpus countingScope including courseId, material subject/relation/polarity/qualifications; scope IDs contain no item or question identifiers. Composite context ID binds the ordered authorized atomic scope IDs and material-contribution partition, not benchmark text.

authorityPrecedence.accepted: Current explicit Owner proposition-scoped semantic-collapse rule, occurrence clarification and preserved prior contract; unchanged C/R predicate/cardinality metric.
authorityPrecedence.authored: v2 contribution-vector/common-refinement and all v3 operational details remain candidate interpretations pending independent IV and explicit Owner acceptance. They cannot override accepted atomic-proposition collapse.
authorityPrecedence.onConflict: SCORING_FAILURE / D3_ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT before computing a number; obtain the exact counting-context decision from Owner.

canonicalization.atomicScope: For each fixed course/proposition scope, construct a graph over approved group declarations with edges only for shared member AND identical approved material subject/relation/polarity/quantification/qualification. Connected components unify redundant declarations of that SAME proposition; reject inconsistent declarations rather than bridge distinct propositions. The canonical group key is SHA256 of scopeId plus sorted component member IDs; group weight remains 1.
canonicalization.compositeContext: Each evidence identity has an ordered contribution vector over the accepted context scopes. A component is the canonical atomic group key, an explicitly accepted distinct contribution key, or explicit NO_CONTRIBUTION. Key = SHA256(contextId + canonical vector). Identities collapse in the composite partition iff their full material contribution vectors match. This is the common refinement (intersection) of atomic partitions; never their transitive union across different propositions.
canonicalization.defaultRule: One unit key per evidence identity in the relevant approved proposition/counting context. No unconditional collapse of all claims within a passage. No accepted contextual-distinct binding -> fail, never a singleton fallback.
canonicalization.multiProposition: One passage may appear in several atomic scopes. Its atomic support contributes once per scope; the item-level C/R calculation uses exactly one approved context key for that evidence identity. Distinct propositions stay in separate vector coordinates. One item invoking multiple propositions requires its pre-approved composite context; no sum of scope ratios.
canonicalization.noPredicateChange: C remains cited/used evidence; R remains its subset bearing on required propositions. Canonicalization only supplies unitKey(e, approved context); it cannot promote an irrelevant identity into R, remove it from C, change required propositions or create an aggregate metric.
canonicalization.overlapExample: Members ending /38,/44,/45,/54,/55 of document 9147fb784fff9cb5c1d1856ac8cf179d80c45a8705564d4c28adadef31b5ef66 may participate in multiple scopes; this never licenses a connected-component merge across PLAY_VOLUNTARY/CREATIVITY_VOLUNTARY/PLAY_PRODUCT/CREATIVITY_PRODUCT.
canonicalization.residualMaterial: Additional independent USED evidence must have an explicit frozen contribution binding; never drop it to make vectors match. Unused surrounding passage prose does not change the evidence contribution. Ambiguous scope or residual assignment fails before counting.

serialization.arrayOrder: scopeId order; group member IDs lexicographic; preserve explicitly bound contribution tuple order
serialization.hash: SHA256 of the serialized object; no ambiguous string concatenation; schema/digests bound before use
serialization.json: compact JSON separators comma/colon, Unicode emitted literally, no trailing newline for counting identities

currentReadiness: D3_RESIDUAL_CLASS_CLOSURE_CANDIDATE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_IV; map authoring complete under bounded dispositions/guards, no IV, Owner acceptance or privileged applicability binding.
deterministicConsumption: Verify complete accepted map, universe, contract, schema, privileged context binding, independent IV PASS and Owner acceptance.

Check Owner-accepted authority before candidate v2/v3 mechanics; reject any conflicting or unaccepted context partition. Procedural exclusions never establish independence. Verify exact used-source span bindings; shared atomic contributions count once and genuinely different outside propositions remain explicit. If both cannot be represented by the accepted partition, fail before computing C/R.
Reject unresolved candidate, missing disposition/contribution, ambiguous scope, non-unit weight, foreign identity or digest drift.
Resolve exact frozen privileged lookup; apply atomic canonicalization and context common refinement; preserve one key per evidence identity in that context.
Compute original |unitKeys(R)|/|unitKeys(C)|; preserve restricted trace and all nine non-compensatory dimensions/gates.

distinctions.distinctPropositions: Separate atomic targets, including type/level subjects and meaningful qualifiers, retain separate coordinates and contributions.
distinctions.privilegedApplicability: Protected required-proposition lookup is separate restricted scorer-side binding, not included or inferred in the public map.
distinctions.proceduralExclusion: Removes current candidate edge from mandatory individual adjudication only; not NOT_EQUIVALENT or independent support.
distinctions.semanticEquivalence: Explicit same atomic proposition, course, subject, predicate, polarity, quantification and qualifications; accepted scoped group required before counting.
distinctions.sourceSpanOverlap: Identical measured source occurrences canonicalized separately from semantic verdict; no second independent contribution from the same used span.
distinctions.unresolved: Any genuinely unknown material applicability/contribution remains explicit and blocks affected consumption; this partial candidate also fails global admission.

duplicatePolicy: Exact and semantic near-duplicate members collapse only through accepted semantic map; hash equality alone cannot replace the semantic rule.
eligiblePassages: All 1999 bound historical passages across 27 documents/16 source bindings; exclude unbound PDS125 and synthetic/current substitutes. Includes unselected passages; selection by protected items is absent.
equivalenceCriteria: Same material proposition with the same course, subject, relation, polarity, quantification, qualifications and author caveats. Paraphrase, reordered wording, spelling and formatting differences may be equivalent.
Topical similarity, one shared sentence, overlapping chunks, copied boilerplate or the same document hash alone do not establish whole-passage equivalence.
Do not merge contradictions, differing modalities, different subjects, different scopes or independent useful propositions. Preserve authority roles and proposition-scoped corrections independently.

Where only one proposition repeats amid distinct passage material, equivalence is target-scoped. An applicable final counting scope must be approved before consumption; ambiguity is not an automatic merge.

formula.betweenGroups: Separate material propositions remain distinguishable. One item-level quotient over its approved context; no cross-course collapse and no summing atomic-scope scores.
formula.empty: EMPTY_DENOMINATOR / NOT_APPLICABLE diagnostic with numerator0,denominator0,score=null; no invented perfect score.
formula.score: numerator/denominator when denominator>0; exact rational counts preserved.
formula.unitKey: unitKey(e, frozenContext) = approved canonical contribution-vector key; exact one key for each identity in C/R. Requires explicitly accepted group/distinct disposition and privileged applicability binding.
formula.withinGroup: Count once per approved equivalent contribution in an atomic scope; item context counts distinct canonical keys once. Repeated citations never add weight.

groupMembership: Partition per course and proposition/counting context, never a global passage-claim partition. Multiple group memberships in separate scopes are permitted; within one atomic scope, explicitly justified equivalent groups are canonicalized before acceptance; conflicting subject/polarity/qualification is an error.

inputSets.C: Distinct cited/used identities actually used as answer evidence, traced from immutable answer and raw product evidence; not every retrieved chunk.
inputSets.R: Subset of C actually bearing on at least one frozen required proposition under preserved D3 predicate. Invalid identity, irrelevant support and negative controls remain in C when used, and cannot enter R.

normalization.databaseIds: Aliases require explicit identity binding; no ordinal inference.
normalization.scope: The final accepted map must declare an unambiguous applicable course/counting scope and proposition target, with no protected item IDs disclosed.

proceduralExclusionConsumption.effect: Skip mandatory individual edge review; retain original pair identity, source-span identity and all separately adjudicated scope memberships. Never insert EXPLICIT_DISTINCT or promote a cited identity into R from this reason code.
proceduralExclusionConsumption.failure: D3_EXCLUDED_PAIR_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED / SCORING_FAILURE; no ratio, singleton fallback, compensation, aggregate or post-hoc adjudication.
proceduralExclusionConsumption.lowLexicalCaveat: Equivalent paraphrases may have little lexical overlap. This procedure limits current frozen review workload; it does not prove global semantic distinctness.
proceduralExclusionConsumption.whenAnswerUsesExcludedPair: Resolve accepted frozen used-span/proposition bindings for both identities. Collapse the same used atomic contribution once. If independence outside that span is claimed, require explicit accepted distinct material contributions.

applyBeforeCounting: Match exact record IDs and used intervals to frozen guards; missing/conflicting applicability fails closed.
Structural/header/title/label spans supply no independent theoretical counting unit; preserve cited/used C and its unchanged relevant subset R.
Repeated atomic/cell/nickname contributions count once within their valid course, subject and qualification scope.
Suppress technical overlap by exact sourceSpanId/fragment binding; keep separately justified outside material distinct.
Do not derive whole-passage equivalence from a shared proposition, row or graph connectivity.
Reject type-specific use of disputed ENFP/ENTP Ne spans; do not repair source or assign both types.

Require an accepted evidence-identity partition satisfying all duplicate-suppression and distinct-contribution conditions. If no such representation is accepted, D3_ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT before computing a number.
residualClassAdmission.authority: Declarative candidate bindings of Owner-accepted proposition-scoped methodology; no acceptance of v2/v3 operational representation. Activation requires independent IV and Owner acceptance.
residualClassAdmission.outsideMaterial: Every retained used material contribution has an explicit accepted disposition or fails closed under USED_MATERIAL_BINDING_REQUIRED.

sourceSpanCanonicalization.fragmentIdentity: An accepted used fragment is (sourceSpanId, relativeStartUtf8, relativeEndUtf8). Bounds must align with the exact shared bytes; the same fragment under the same atomic proposition is one contribution. Different slices that support the same proposition require an accepted common semantic contribution, not independence by unequal endpoints.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.identity: SHA256 of compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON identityPayload: courseId/sourceSlug/documentIdentity plus both sorted exact member-local UTF-8 occurrence intervals and span hash. D3SPAN prefix. No canonical document offsets are invented.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.metric: No span weights, fractional units or summed atomic ratios. C/R predicates and |unitKeys(R)|/|unitKeys(C)| remain unchanged. One accepted unit key per evidence identity per approved counting context.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.mixedCompositeContext: Before using v2 contribution vectors, independently verify and obtain Owner acceptance of an exact context partition that both preserves outside material and avoids duplicate independent credit for repeated source contributions. If common refinement gives separate keys whose only relevant support is the same shared atomic span, reject that partition with D3_SOURCE_SPAN_INDEPENDENCE_UNRESOLVED rather than count two.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.multipleMemberships: Apply same-scope semantic canonicalization first; shared-span occurrences carry the same canonical atomic contribution. Preserve different genuine propositions as separate scopes. No cross-course or cross-proposition transitive union.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.outsideSpan: Outside intervals retain their exact authorized member identity and byte bounds; admit them as independent only under an explicit accepted distinct atomic-proposition contribution. Do not discard used outside material to make vectors match.
sourceSpanCanonicalization.scope: All 1958 adjacent candidate overlaps, including semantic exceptions, not merely the 1913 excluded edges.
